title: Run a Shopify Store with a Bot Team
summary: One bot works the catalog and conversion, one coordinates orders, ads and stock, one drafts customer replies.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes a store with steady orders; gains scale with your sales volume.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer missed orders, stockouts and slow replies.
More time for product and marketing.
who_its_for: Shopify store owners and small e-commerce teams.

stack.name: Shopify Bot
stack.role: Works on catalog, inventory, conversion and service through Shopify.
stack.creator: nick_nehaul

stack.name: Store Manager
stack.role: Coordinates store bots across orders, ads, stock and disputes.
stack.creator: ColinMcDermott

stack.name: Reply Desk
stack.role: Drafts replies to customer messages and reviews.
stack.creator: lonzom10

steps: Start with Shopify Bot on low-risk tasks.
Add Store Manager once you trust the daily digest.
Route customer messages to Reply Desk drafts.
Widen access one task at a time.
guardrails: Shopify Bot can change a live store; test first.
Store Manager never spends money on its own.
